title: Account Recalls and Recall Fees — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**Recall right.** A creditor client under the Contingency Placement Agreements may recall any open placed account at any time through an account recall service request, and the account is returned under the account charter.

**When a fee can be assessed.** A recall fee is assessed only on a recall whose service request has the request status processed, as the service request record shows.

**Free recalls.** The recall is free in any of these cases:

1. the recall request's request date is no later than the tier's free recall window, in calendar days, after the account's placement date;
2. the recall reason is bankruptcy, deceased, billing error or dispute with client;
3. the agreement's free-recall usage is still below the tier's free recall allowance percent. Free-recall usage is the count of account recall requests on the agreement processed without a recall fee under the free-recall allowance, divided by the count of accounts placed under the agreement in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the handling date, both ends included, expressed as a percentage.

**Arrangement and payment test.** Otherwise a fee is charged when, on the request date, the account's status was arranged or a consumer payment had posted within the tier's payment lookback, in calendar days, before the request date; a recall of an account with neither is free.

**Amount.** The fee is the account's balance due on the request date multiplied by the stage contingency rate and by the tier's recall fee share percent, rounded to the cent, and never more than the tier's recall fee cap. One fee at most is charged per recalled account.

## Decision table

| Free window met | Fee-free reason | Usage below allowance | Arranged, or payment within lookback | Recall fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | any | any | none |
| no | yes | any | any | none |
| no | no | yes | any | none |
| no | no | no | yes | charged |
| no | no | no | no | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- Balance due 3000.00 USD on a Primary Placement account, stage rate 30.0 percent, recall fee share 100.0 percent, cap 2500.00 USD: 3000.00 USD multiplied by 30.0 percent and by 100.0 percent is 900.00 USD, below the cap, so the fee is 900.00 USD.
- Balance due 8000.00 USD, stage rate 35.0 percent, recall fee share 50.0 percent, cap 1000.00 USD: 8000.00 USD multiplied by 35.0 percent and by 50.0 percent is 1400.00 USD, above the cap, so the fee is 1000.00 USD.
- The same account recalled with the reason deceased: no fee.
